tagline: Turn your daily Anki reviews into a streak worth keeping.
reopen_from_telegram: Reopen DeckStreak from Telegram to sign in again.
server_unavailable: DeckStreak could not reach its server. Try again in a moment.
about_license: DeckStreak is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later, and its complete source code is public.
score_none: Today has no score yet. Send /sync to the bot to compute it now.
score_pillars: The five pillars of the score
level_progress_text: {into} of {next} XP to the next level
level_ascendant: Ascendant day: today's XP earns a bonus
level_exchange_caption: XP paid per graduated card, by source
level_exchange_none: No XP has been earned yet, so there is no rate to show.
streak_at_stake_freeze: A freeze covers one missed day.
streak_at_stake_break: Studying today keeps this streak going.
governor_standby: Standby: your habit strength is below the arming level.
governor_lapse: Lapse: {count} reviews on one day relight it.
insights_no_report: This instrument has not run yet.
insights_failed_read: This read failed, so nothing is claimed: {reads}.
insights_running: A run is in progress. Try again in a moment.
dark_fields_none: Checked {types} note types over {notes} reviewed notes: no dark fields.
dark_fields_cold: There was nothing to check yet.
dark_fields_unparseable: Templates that could not be verified: {names}.
badges_none: No badges yet — study to earn your first!
records_none: No records yet — they mint themselves as you study.
capture_text_hint: Up to {max} characters. It lands in your vault's inbox.
capture_failed: Not saved. Your text is still here, so try again in a moment.
progress_none: Road to C2 has no course yet: it appears after your next sync.
law_tiers_unavailable: The law cards by tier cannot be shown right now.
remote_intro: Reads a gamepad, or a remote in keyboard mode, and logs every event. It sends nothing anywhere.
remote_no_gamepad: No gamepad yet. Press a button on it to connect it.
remote_log_caption: The last 200 events, the newest first
study_refused_bad_request: The study screen asked the engine for something it could not read. Try again.
study_refused_collection_busy: Your collection is open in another tab. Close it there, then try again.
study_refused_storage: This browser would not keep your collection. Allow this site to store data, then try again.
study_refused_engine: The study engine stopped. Try again.
study_refused_not_open: Your collection is not open yet. Try again.
study_refused_not_shown: That card was no longer on screen, so the review showed the card that is.
study_card_escaped: This card cannot be shown safely here. You can still answer, bury or flag it.
study_done: This deck is done for today.
study_no_decks: There is no deck to study yet.
study_late_review: This card was due on an earlier day, so this review does not count toward the streak for that day.
undo_unsynced: This answer has not synced yet. Undoing it removes it from your review history; nothing else changes.
undo_synced: Your last answer has synced, so it can no longer be undone.
undo_gone: This answer can no longer be undone: something changed after it.
undo_no_text: This card has no text to show.
study_mapping_intro: Choose a key or a button below, then press the one you want on your remote. This device keeps its own mapping.
study_mapping_press_key: Press the new key for {action}. Escape cancels.
study_mapping_press_button: Press the new gamepad button for {action}. Escape cancels.
sync_status_absent: You are not signed in to sync.
sync_status_sealed: Signed in. Your sign-in opens at the next sync.
sync_status_held: Signed in and ready to sync.
sync_status_needs_sign_in: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again to sync.
sync_status_offline: The sync server cannot be reached right now. Your reviews stay on this device.
sync_in_step: This device and the server hold the same collection.
sync_full_required: The server and this device changed in ways a normal sync cannot merge. Choose which copy to keep.
sync_lost: This browser holds no copy of your collection. Download the server's copy to restore it.
sync_choice_upload_loses: The server's copy is replaced: it loses {reviews} reviews, {cards} cards and {notes} notes this device lacks.
sync_choice_download_loses: This device's copy is replaced: it loses {reviews} reviews, {cards} cards and {notes} notes the server lacks.
sync_choice_snapshot_age: The server's newest saved snapshot was taken {age}.
sync_choice_snapshot_waits: A saved snapshot of the server's copy cannot be confirmed yet, so keeping this device's copy waits until one can.
sync_choice_changed_server: The server's copy changed since the count. These are the new counts.
sync_choice_changed_device: This device recorded a review since the count. These are the new counts.
sync_choice_refused: Nothing was replaced. You can try again.
sync_backups_none: This browser holds no backup yet.
sync_backup_removed: Removed to keep the newest three of each kind: {backup}
sync_storage_persisted: This browser keeps this site's storage.
sync_storage_not_persisted: This browser may clear this site's storage when it needs room.
sync_storage_unknown: This browser cannot tell whether it keeps this site's storage.
sync_storage_evicted: If it clears your collection, download the server's copy to restore it.
signin_no_webauthn: This browser can't use passkeys. Open DeckStreak in a browser that can, or reopen it from Telegram.
signin_not_linked: No passkey is linked yet. Link one from DeckStreak in Telegram.
passkey_refused: That passkey can't sign in to DeckStreak.
passkey_start_again: That attempt expired or was already used. Start again.
passkey_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then start again.
passkey_cancelled: No passkey was used. You can start again.
link_open_in_browser: Open this link in your browser to create a passkey.
link_no_code: This link has no code. Get a new one from DeckStreak in Telegram.
link_code_spent: This link expired or was already used. Get a new one from DeckStreak in Telegram.
link_done: Passkey created. You can now sign in to DeckStreak in this browser.
methods_remove_confirm: Remove this passkey? You can still sign in with Telegram.
methods_reopen: Reopen DeckStreak from Telegram, then try again.
